notes: Path convention: @ maps to src. Components and source-private dependencies live under @/components/huemo/<source>/; other shared dependencies live under @/components/huemo/shared/. @/lib/utils is provided separately: merge cn if it already exists; do not overwrite the project implementation.

Connect semantic color classes such as bg-card and text-foreground to the target theme. In Tailwind v4, map roles in @theme inline, e.g. --color-card: var(--card) and --color-foreground: var(--foreground). Preserve existing light and dark definitions.

In TypeScript, include DOM, DOM.Iterable and ESNext (including Intl.Segmenter types) in tsconfig.compilerOptions.lib. For older browsers without Intl.Segmenter, add a segmentation polyfill or upgrade the browser.
